title: Short Swords Plus
description: Short Swords Plus is a lightweight PvP resource pack that shortens sword models for better visibility and cleaner combat. Designed for competitive gameplay while keeping a smooth vanilla-style look.
body:
Short Swords Plus is a PvP-focused resource pack that reduces the length of sword models to improve visibility during combat. By keeping weapons shorter and cleaner, it helps reduce screen clutter so you can track fights more easily.

The pack stays close to a vanilla style while making small visual tweaks that improve clarity in fast-paced PvP situations. It works well in all PvP modes, especially Crystal PvP and general competitive play.
